metadata.title: Theo Johnson - Won't play Sunday
metadata.description: Johnson (neck) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Texans, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
metadata.analysis: Johnson's lack of participation in Friday's practice session appears to have been indicative of his playing status for Sunday's contest. The tight end will not be able to overcome his neck injury in time for Week 7 and will have to look towards the Giants' Week 9 contest against the Eagles after the bye.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson - Unlikely to play against Houston
metadata.description: Johnson (neck) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Texans.
metadata.analysis: Johnson's reps in each of the first two practices of Week 7 prep were limited due to a neck injury, and he was sidelined entirely for Friday's session. He's trending toward missing a second consecutive game, so Thomas Fidone and Chris Manhertz would both be in line for more work behind Isaiah Likely in the event that Johnson is ruled out for Sunday's contest.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson - Still limited at practice Thursday
metadata.description: Johnson (neck) was a limited participant at practice Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Johnson was back at practice Wednesday after being sidelined because of a neck injury in Week 6 versus the Saints, but another day later, it's still hindering him ahead of a Week 7 tilt at Houston. He'll probably have to log a full practice Friday to avoid carrying an injury designation into the weekend.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson (neck) considered limited again Thursday
metadata.description: Theo Johnson (neck) was considered a limited participant at practice again on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Johnson has been limited at both practices to start the week while he recovers from a neck issue. Not much should change from a fantasy standpoint even if he's ruled out for this week, however.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson (neck) limited participant Wednesday
metadata.description: Theo Johnson (neck) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Johnson didn't play due to a neck issue last week, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday and seems to be gearing up to play in Week 7. He won't be fantasy relevant even if active, however.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson - Back at practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Johnson (neck) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Johnson was practicing in a limited capacity in the leadup to the Giants' matchup versus the Saints in Week 6, but he ultimately downgraded to missing practice later in the week before sitting out that contest. He'll likely have to participate fully in practice Thursday or Friday to dodge taking an injury designation into the weekend.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson - Ruled out against New Orleans
metadata.description: Johnson (neck) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Saints.
metadata.analysis: A neck injury limited Johnson's practice participation Wednesday and Thursday, but he was a DNP for Friday's session before being subsequently ruled out for Sunday's contest. In his absence, Chris Manhertz and Thomas Fidone are candidates to step into the TE2 role behind Isaiah Likely. Johnson's next chance to play is Week 7 against the Texans on Sunday, Oct. 25.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson (neck) ruled out Sunday
metadata.description: Theo Johnson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Saints.
metadata.analysis: Johnson did not practice on Friday. He remains off the fantasy radar.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson (neck) limited participant Thursday
metadata.description: Theo Johnson (neck) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Johnson was able to practice in a limited capacity again on Thursday. It looks like he will be available to play in Week 6, but even if he is, fantasy managers shouldn't be expecting him to score many points against the Saints this week.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson - Dealing with neck injury
metadata.description: Johnson (neck) was listed as a limited practice participant on Wednesday's injury report, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Johnson caught two of three passes for 35 yards during the Giants' 27-27 tie against the Commanders in Week 5, but he may have tweaked his neck at some point during the game. He would avoid an injury tag for Sunday's contest against the Saints if he can log a full practice in one of the next two days of practice.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson (neck) limited in practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Theo Johnson was limited in practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Johnson remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson quiet in Week 5
metadata.description: Theo Johnson caught two of his three targets for 35 yards in the Giants' 27-27 tie with the Washington Commanders in Week 5.
metadata.analysis: Johnson has struggled to make an impact in the New York passing attack to this point, finishing under 40 receiving yards in each of the first five contests. The tight end remains best left off rosters with Isaiah Likely remaining healthy ahead of a Week 6 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson - Secures 11-yard TD in win
metadata.description: Johnson caught his lone target for an 11-yard touchdown in Sunday's 36-24 win over the Cardinals.
metadata.analysis: Johnson caught the third of Jameis Winston's three touchdowns, scoring from 11 yards out late in the third quarter to give the G-Men a 27-24 lead. Working more as a blocker alongside Isaiah Likely in a pass-catching role, Johnson has just two catches for 20 yards and a touchdown on six targets this season.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson finds end zone Sunday
metadata.description: Theo Johnson caught one pass for 11 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 36-24 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
metadata.analysis: Johnson caught his lone target on Sunday and was able to turn it into an 11-yard touchdown, which helped in New York's win over the Cardinals. That was his lone target on the day though, so his workload will continue to prevent him from being fantasy relevant moving forward.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson Heavily Phased Out of Giants' Offense
metadata.description: New York Giants tight end Theo Johnson's volume has taken a massive hit this season. After finishing as the TE18 with 74 targets and 48 catches in his second pro season last year, Johnson has just five targets, one reception, and nine yards in 2026. We knew his role was going to be threatened by the signing of Isaiah Likely, but nobody predicted a downfall this drastic. Johnson has played 46% and 28% of the snaps in his first two games this year, respectively. He did command four targets in Week 2 with Jameis Winston at quarterback, but he didn't catch any of those passes. Johnson could get back onto the fantasy radar if Likely misses any time, but for now, Likely is healthy and Johnson can be left on waivers in almost all leagues.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson - Four targets, zero catches in Week 2 loss
metadata.description: Johnson played 16 of the Giants' 58 offensive snaps but did not haul in any of his four targets during Monday's 28-6 loss to the Rams.
metadata.analysis: All four of Johnson's targets came in the first half, three of which were in the opening quarter. The third-year tight end failed to record a catch, but he did log a tackle on Trent McDuffie after the latter intercepted Jameis Winston midway through the second quarter. Johnson is firmly behind Isaiah Likely on the depth chart, though all of the Giants pass catchers figure to see their production dip with Winston under center instead of Jaxson Dart, the latter of whom could miss the rest of the season due to a knee injury.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson - Limited offensive production in Week 1
metadata.description: Johnson caught his only target for nine yards in Sunday night's 28-20 win over the Cowboys.
metadata.analysis: Johnson operated as a clear second-fiddle to Isaiah Likely at tight end in Week 1, with the latter reeling in all eight of his targets for 78 yards and two scores in the game. Johnson was only on the field for 32 of the team's 69 offensive snaps, and as long as Likely is available, he won't have much fantasy appeal this season.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson held to one catch Sunday
metadata.description: Theo Johnson caught just one pass for nine yards in Sunday night's 28-20 win over the Dallas Cowboys.
metadata.analysis: New York didn't get their tight end very involved on Sunday night, as he was held to just one catch in the team's win over their divisional rival. Isaiah Likely proved himself to be far and away their most talented receiver at the tight end position in this matchup, so Johnson will likely continue to be relegated to a blocking and depth role for the foreseeable future.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson (shoulder) logs full practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Theo Johnson (shoulder) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: It looks like the Giants will have Johnson available to play for them on Sunday, as he was able to log a full practice to start the week on Wednesday. He won't carry any fantasy value himself but should serve as a nice depth option for Jaxson Dart moving forward.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson - Full practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Johnson (shoulder) was a full practice participant Wednesday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Johnson is coming off a 2025 regular season in which he posted a 45-528-5 line on 74 targets in 15 games, but the arrival of TE Isaiah Likely via free agency has provided the former with some competition at the position ahead of his third pro campaign. With the shoulder injury he picked up in an Aug. 24 practice behind Johnson, he'll focus on being a regular part of the Giants offense in Sunday's Week 1 matchup with the Cowboys.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson's Redraft Stock Has Slipped
metadata.description: New York Giants tight end Theo Johnson still has a role, but the fantasy case has taken a hit. Johnson was productive last season, finishing with 45 catches for 528 yards and five touchdowns, yet Isaiah Likely has been the more prominent receiving option throughout camp. Likely caught six passes during live work in the Aug. 20 joint practice with Miami and was described by Jordan Raanan as one of Jaxson Dart's favorite targets. Johnson, meanwhile, had a quiet camp before a shoulder injury cost him additional practice time late in August. Head coach John Harbaugh has said Johnson should be ready for Week 1, so the injury itself is not the main concern. The bigger issue is where the targets are going. RotoBaller has Likely at TE15 in its September half-PPR rankings and Johnson at TE42. Johnson should still see the field, especially in two-tight-end sets, but he is looking more like a secondary option in the passing game than a breakout candidate.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson (shoulder) practices in non-contact jersey
metadata.description: Theo Johnson practiced on Tuesday wearing a non-contact jersey.
metadata.analysis: Johnson will have the next week and a half to get fully healthy for the start of the season.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson - Donning non-contact jersey at practice
metadata.description: Johnson (shoulder) is participating in Monday's practice in a non-contact jersey, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.
metadata.analysis: Johnson was injured in practice last Monday and continues to deal with the injury, though his return to action would suggest the tight end is on track to play Week 1 against the Cowboys. Johnson figures to work mostly as a blocker this season after the Giants signed Isaiah Likely to a contract over the offseason.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson Wears Non-Contact Jersey at Monday's Practice
metadata.description: New York Giants tight end Theo Johnson (shoulder) was wearing a red, non-contact jersey at the team's practice on Monday, according to Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News. Johnson is still not a full-go this week after injuring his shoulder in practice last Monday. The fact that the 25-year-old was even out there on Monday suggests that he should be fine for the Week 1 season opener on Sunday night, Sept. 13, against the division-rival Dallas Cowboys. The former fourth-round selection in the 2024 NFL draft from Penn State improved in his second season in 2025, catching 45 of his 74 targets for 528 yards and five touchdowns in 15 starts after posting a 29-331-1 line in 12 games as a rookie. Johnson could have a decent role in his third NFL campaign in a Giants offense that figures to utilize plenty of two-tight-end sets, but unless Isaiah Likely misses time with an injury, his fantasy football ceiling will be low in an offense that wants to ground and pound. At RotoBaller, Johnson is ranked as the No. 42 fantasy TE, so he should only be drafted for depth in two-TE leagues.

metadata.title: Theo Johnson - Dealing with shoulder injury
metadata.description: Johnson missed Wednesday's practice due to a shoulder injury, Evan Barnes of Newsday reports.
metadata.analysis: Johnson made an early exit Monday and hasn't yet returned, but there's been no indication of a serious injury that would jeopardize his Week 1 status. Giants coach John Harbaugh said Wednesday that Johnson will be ready for the season opener, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.
